title: Lior and the Autopsy
author: Sable Reyes
blurb: Felix Iversen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
